I just finished watching the newest episode of my favorite baking show last night, and I’ve been obsessing over the sourdough loaf one of the contestants made all day, I even looked up three different recipes to try making it this weekend. My neighbor dropped off a jar of homemade strawberry jam this morning too, it’s so sweet I think it’ll pair perfectly with the bread if I can get the recipe right. I also picked up a new cast iron Dutch oven on sale last week that I’m dying to test out for the bake, I’ve heard they make the crust turn out perfectly crispy every time.
Anyway, I need to update the shipping address for my existing order, my user ID is lucas_santos_6600, the new address is 943 Maple Drive, Suite 356, Chicago, IL 60621, USA.
